I don’t have live web access in this chat, so I can’t pull today’s headlines directly. If you’d like, I can summarize any links you share, or give you a quick catch‑up on major NVIDIA developments up to late 2024.

If you want the very latest right now, here are reliable, up‑to‑date sources you can open:
- Google News (broad): https://news.google.com/search?q=NVIDIA OR https://news.google.com/search?q=NVDA
- Reuters company page (near real time): https://www.reuters.com/companies/NVDA.O
- Bloomberg NVIDIA topic: https://www.bloomberg.com/topics/companies/nvidia-corp (may be paywalled)
- NVIDIA Investor Relations newsroom: https://investor.nvidia.com/news/
- NVIDIA corporate blog: https://blogs.nvidia.com/
- Tech press for product/benchmarks:
  - AnandTech (NVIDIA): https://www.anandtech.com/tag/nvidia
  - Tom’s Hardware (NVIDIA): https://www.tomshardware.com/tags/nvidia
  - The Verge (NVIDIA tag): https://www.theverge.com/tags/nvidia

Tell me which articles or topics you’re most interested in (earnings/stock, AI chips like Blackwell/GB200, data center deals, regulation/China, gaming/RTX, automotive), and I’ll provide a concise summary and context. If you want, I can also draft Google Alerts or RSS feeds tailored to your focus.
